title: Resource-Bounded Learning Algorithm
statement: A learning algorithm for a finite hypothesis representation and a specified access model assigns a learning program to each requested accuracy, and specifies its success probability and uniform bounds on random-example calls, membership queries, and local work. For every Boolean target and accuracy, the specified success probability equals the probability that the program outputs a represented hypothesis whose relative Hamming distance from the target is at most the requested accuracy. Every outcome in the support of the program's run with cost obeys all three advertised resource bounds.
hypotheses_covered: Finite hypothesis representation of Boolean functions on $n$ inputs
